experiment: Orthogonal composite of Phase89 g5/g6 full192 anti-P10 and Phase90 symmetric clamp-floor scaling
purpose: Combine two fixed mechanisms whose validation support is concentrated in complementary folds: stable g5/g6 full-frequency PAS correction and parameter-free low-energy UE clamp repair. Test their exact interaction on top of the official-best Phase40 family.

reference.candidate: exact Phase40 official-feedback anti-P10 PAS eta=0.50 channel

fixed_composition.step2: Apply the exact Phase79 full-192 Gaussian local PAS correction only in official groups 5 and 6 with dose 0.20.
fixed_composition.step3: Apply the exact Phase40 anti-P10 PAS eta=0.50 direction computed from the original P9/P10 descriptors, in the same order and implementation as Phase89.
fixed_composition.step4: Compute the exact frozen Phase90 per-sample-by-UE scale from the original P9 prediction, not from truth and not from the intermediate composite.
fixed_composition.step5: Broadcast that positive Phase90 scale over all BS antennas and subcarriers of the corresponding UE branch of the step3 channel.
fixed_composition.reason_for_original_p9_scale_source: It preserves the two previously frozen modules exactly and prevents interaction-conditioned threshold tuning.

validation.heldout_truth_use: Each fold truth is used only for final scoring after every transform and scale is determined without heldout truth.
required_integrity: Phase90 scale-one UE branches bitwise equal to Phase89
no test truth, test artifact, or upload

after_validation.if_pass: A separate frozen build phase may construct the official 500-row test NPY, perform byte-level QA, and upload a GitHub release.
after_validation.if_fail: Retire this exact composite with no strength or order adjustment.
